role: Defines RespiratoryBaselineCache, a UserDefaults-backed 30-day last-known-good 7-day respiratory-rate baseline used when HealthKit is unreachable (locked phone) for today's reading, and BaselineSnapshot (Codable value + timestamp) with the shared read/write helpers and age limit used by both baseline caches.
types: RespiratoryBaselineCache: enum — static read/write/clear over UserDefaults, forwarding to BaselineSnapshot
BaselineSnapshot: struct — Codable value/lastUpdated plus shared static read(key:maxAgeSeconds:), write(_:key:) and maxAgeSeconds; shape shared by the respiratory and wrist-temperature caches
toplevel: The doc comment above RespiratoryBaselineCache explains the cache; BaselineSnapshot follows it. Older stored snapshots also hold a sampleCount key, ignored when decoding.

units.does: Returns the cached respiratory baseline snapshot (<= BaselineSnapshot.maxAgeSeconds, 30 days, old) via BaselineSnapshot.read.
Stores value as the respiratory baseline snapshot (stamped now) via BaselineSnapshot.write under RespiratoryBaselineCache.v1.
Removes RespiratoryBaselineCache.v1 from UserDefaults. Called by DataPurgeService.swift:701.
Reads Data at UserDefaults.standard[key], JSON-decodes a BaselineSnapshot and returns it unless it is older than maxAgeSeconds measured from Date() now.

branches.cond: no data under key, or JSON decode fails (try?)
branches.effect: returns nil; decode error swallowed silently (no log), else continue

branches.cond: snapshot lastUpdated more than maxAgeSeconds before now

units.does: JSON-encodes BaselineSnapshot(value, lastUpdated: now) and stores it at UserDefaults.standard[key]; an encode failure is logged through attempt as '<key>.encode' and nothing is stored.
